<table class="jtable" style="float: right; width: 90%">
<caption style="font-size: 1.4em; font-weight: bold; text-align:left; border-bottom: 2px solid #6678b1;">Did you know...
</caption>
<tbody><tr>
<td><div class="didyouknow">
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="Smooth"><a href="/index.php/Smooth" title="Smooth">Smooth</a></span></h3>
<p><a href="/index.php/Smooth" title="Smooth">Smooth</a> performs a window average of coordinate states.
</p>
<h1><span class="mw-headline" id="Usage">Usage</span></h1>
<div class="mw-highlight mw-content-ltr" dir="ltr"><pre><span></span><span class="n">smooth</span> <span class="p">[</span> <span class="n">selection</span> <span class="p">[,</span> <span class="n">passes</span> <span class="p">[,</span> <span class="n">window</span> <span class="p">[,</span> <span class="n">first</span> <span class="p">[,</span> <span class="n">last</span> <span class="p">[,</span> <span class="n">ends</span><span class="p">]]]]]]</span>

<span class="c1"># for example, smooth and object with 30 passes and</span>
<span class="c1"># a window size of 100.</span>
<span class="n">smooth</span> <span class="n">myObj</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">30</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">100</span>
</pre></div>
<ul><li>ends = 0 or 1: controls whether or not the end states are also smoothed using a weighted asymmetric window</li></ul>
<p>To see smooth in context see this <a class="external text" href="http://www.pymolwiki.org/index.php/Protect#Example" rel="nofollow">example</a>
</p>
<h1><span class="mw-headline" id="NOTES">NOTES</span></h1>
<ul><li>This type of averaging is often used to suppress high-frequency vibrations in a molecular dynamics trajectory.</li>
<li>This function is not memory efficient.  For reasons of flexibility, it uses two additional copies of every atomic coordinate for the calculation.  If you are memory-constrained in visualizing MD trajectories, then you may want to use an external tool such as ptraj to perform smoothing before loading coordinates into PyMOL.</li></ul>
<h1><span class="mw-headline" id="See_Also">See Also</span></h1>
<p><a class="mw-redirect" href="/index.php/Load_Traj" title="Load Traj">Load_Traj</a>, <a href="/index.php/Protect" title="Protect">protect</a>.
</p>
</div>
<div style="clear: both;"></div>
</td></tr></tbody></table>
